Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

The nearest bus stop is called Foundry Lane; the band has not compared bus times with the train schedule. No one has agreed who will carry the shared microphone stand.

The payment note Leon sent says a 25 percent deposit is due when the booking is confirmed, with the balance payable at the front desk on arrival. He accepts card or cash at the desk. Mara asked if the deposit is refundable when a band cancels, and Leon sent the general cancellation terms: cancellations made more than 72 hours before the slot receive the deposit back; cancellations within 72 hours forfeit it. The terms do not say how a change of date is handled. Leon also said, “I’ll hold a room for one day while you check with everyone,” but did not specify which room or give the date and time when that hold expires. Mara has not treated the message as a confirmed booking.

1. On Monday, Mara asked for Thursday the 18th at 6:30 p.m. for three hours. Leon responded that the calendar showed Rooms A and B as open after 5:30, while Room C was unavailable until 8:00. His message did not reserve a room.
2. On Tuesday, Dev asked whether Room B’s larger vocal monitor would be suitable for the group’s harmony practice. Leon forwarded the equipment description but did not answer the suitability question.
3. Later Tuesday, Rowan asked about arriving before the paid slot. Leon said he could ask the evening manager about access at 6:15 and had no confirmation yet.
4. On Wednesday morning, Inez said she could reach the studio around 6:20 if work ended on time. She did not ask the employer to change her finish time.
5. On Wednesday afternoon, Mara asked about staying beyond 9:30. Leon replied with the written-end-time condition and the $12 late-access fee described above.

The band has not chosen a room, confirmed its final arrival time, or decided whether to request an end time later than 9:30. Mara wants to compare the listed room features and prices against the band’s stated needs before replying to Leon. She also wants the unanswered cymbal, monitor, early-access, parking, and date-change questions visible when the group discusses the booking. If the group requests an end time after 9:30, Leon’s stated condition about writing that time on the booking applies; the notes do not establish that the studio will approve an extension.
